description: This file contains Swift extension methods for the `CronSettings` class or struct, defining various SwiftUI views to display and interact with cron jobs including job rows, context menus, detail headers, detail cards, run history, and payload summaries.

methods.name: jobRow
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI view representing a cron job row with job details, including display name, status, and conditional UI elements for job state.

methods.name: jobContextMenu
methods.description: Provides a context menu with actions for a specified cron job, including running, opening transcript, enabling/disabling, editing, and deleting the job.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Builds a detailed header view for a cron job, showing name, ID, and action buttons like run, transcript, and edit.

methods.name: detailCard
methods.description: Constructs a detailed information card for a cron job, including schedule, description, agent, session, wake mode, last run info, status, and payload summary.

methods.name: runHistoryCard
methods.description: Displays the run history of a cron job, including refresh controls, loading indicators, and list of run entries.

methods.name: runRow
methods.description: Creates a view for an individual run log entry, showing status, date, duration, summary, and error info.

methods.name: payloadSummary
methods.description: Displays a summary of the payload associated with a cron job, handling different payload types with conditional views.
